description: This Java class 'CheckOutEvents' handles checkout and order processing events in an e-commerce system, including order creation, payment processing, shipping, tax calculation, and order validation.

classes.name: CheckOutEvents
classes.description: Handles checkout and order processing events including order creation, payment, shipping, tax, and validation.

methods.name: cartNotEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the shopping cart is not empty.

methods.name: setCheckOutPages
methods.description: Manages checkout page flow based on current step and validation.

methods.name: determineInitialCheckOutPage
methods.description: Determines the initial checkout page based on cart conditions.

methods.name: setCheckOutError
methods.description: Sets checkout error message based on current page.

methods.name: setQuickCheckOutOptions
methods.description: Calculates tax and sets checkout options for quick checkout.

methods.name: setPartialCheckOutOptions
methods.description: Sets partial checkout options.

methods.name: setCartShipToCustomerParty
methods.description: Sets the shipping party ID in the cart.

methods.name: checkPaymentMethods
methods.description: Validates payment methods in the cart.

methods.name: getSelectedPaymentMethods
methods.description: Retrieves selected payment methods from request parameters.

methods.name: setCheckOutOptions
methods.description: Sets checkout options including payment, shipping, and billing.

methods.name: checkoutValidation
methods.description: Validates that necessary checkout info is present.

methods.name: createOrder
methods.description: Creates an order using the createOrder service.

methods.name: calcTax
methods.description: Calculates tax for the current cart.

methods.name: explodeOrderItems
methods.description: Determines if order items should be exploded based on store settings.

methods.name: checkShipmentNeeded
methods.description: Checks if shipment is needed based on cart contents and store settings.

methods.name: processPayment
methods.description: Processes payment and approves order.

methods.name: checkOrderDenylist
methods.description: Checks if order is on denylist.

methods.name: failedDenylistCheck
methods.description: Handles denylist check failure and session invalidation.

methods.name: checkExternalCheckout
methods.description: Checks if external checkout (e.g., PayPal) is used.

methods.name: checkExternalPayment
methods.description: Checks external payment status.

methods.name: finalizeOrderEntry
methods.description: Finalizes order entry, including shipping, options, and payment.

methods.name: determineNextFinalizeStep
methods.description: Determines the next step in the checkout process.

methods.name: finalizeOrderEntryError
methods.description: Handles errors during order finalization.

methods.name: determineBillingAccountAmount
methods.description: Calculates the billing account amount to use.

methods.name: createReplacementOrder
methods.description: Creates a replacement order from an existing one.
